# Packages
```{r packages echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse) # Inc dplyr, ggplot2, lubridate etc
library(readxl) # For reading in excel files
```


#Introduction

Gorgonian octocorals are important structural and suspension-feeding components of tropical coral reefs, yet baseline ecological data across many Western Indian Ocean reef systems remain sparse. This project builds on preliminary, unpublished Bachelor of Science with Honours field surveys conducted across reef sites in Mauritius and Rodrigues, where no prior quantitative baseline existed for these surveyed locations.

Originally, these dive survey logs, colony measurements, and water-column nutrient/chlorophyll-a records were stored in fragmented spreadsheets and analyzed through siloed, manual workflows. Here, that preliminary baseline dataset is migrated into a reproducible `tidyverse` pipeline in R and paired with Google Earth Engine (GEE) spatial oceanography (`HYCOM` surface current speed) to:

1. Characterize gorgonian abundance, coral cover, and colony morphometrics (height and width) across sites in Mauritius and Rodrigues;
2. Examine relationships between gorgonian patterns, water-column nutrients/chlorophyll-a, and regional current speed; and
3. Document a transparent methodological shift from manual, spreadsheet-based undergraduate analyses toward reproducible, code-driven marine data science.

# Creating clean_name function

```{r}
# Helper function to make column names clean case 
clean_name <- function(df) {
  names(df) <- names(df) |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") |>
    str_remove_all("^_|_$")
  df
}
```


# Standardising

Applying clean_name function to all dataframes and standardising the island and site spelling across all tables

```{r}
dive_clean <- dive |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  )

transect_clean <- transect |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  )

nutrients_clean <- nutrient_data |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  )

gee_clean <- gee_currents |>
  clean_name() |>
  mutate(
    island = str_squish(island),
    site   = str_squish(str_to_title(site)),
    site   = recode(site, "Seafan Valley" = "Sea Fan Valley")
  ) |>
  select(island, site, hycom_current_speed = mean)
```

#Summarising colony morphometrics

Summarising them per site by finding the mean and standard error

```{r}
colony_site <- dive_clean |>
  filter(!is.na(height)) |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies  = n(),
    mean_height = mean(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_height   = sd(height, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_width  = mean(width, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_depth  = mean(depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(colony_site)
```
#Summarising lab nutrients and chl_a

summarised by site, calculating the mean and standard error

```{r}
nutrients_site <- nutrients_clean |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(silicate, phosphate, nitrate, chl_a),
      list(
        mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        se   = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.x)))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(
    chl_a_lab_mean = chl_a_mean,
    chl_a_lab_se   = chl_a_se
  )
```


#Joining all tables in one master_site dataset

```{r}
master_site <- transect_clean |>
  left_join(colony_site, by = c("island", "site")) |>
  left_join(nutrients_site, by = c("island", "site")) |>
  left_join(gee_clean, by = c("island", "site"))

master_site
```

# comparing gorgonian size with nutrient at each site

```{r}

# 1. Inspect column names in your cleaned dive & nutrient tables first
# names(dive_clean)
# names(nutrients_clean)

# 2. Calculate colony surface-area proxy per colony, then summarize per site
# Adjust `height` and `width` to match your exact cleaned column names
colony_size_site <- dive_clean |>
  filter(!is.na(height), !is.na(width), height > 0, width > 0) |>
  mutate(
    colony_area_proxy = height * width # e.g., cm² if height & width are in cm
  ) |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies = n(),
    mean_height = mean(height, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_height = sd(height, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_colonies),
    mean_width = mean(width, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_width = sd(width, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_colonies),
    mean_area = mean(colony_area_proxy, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_area = sd(colony_area_proxy, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_colonies),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

#comparing no of colonies per site
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Option A: If using `colony_size_site` (sites with measured colonies)
# colony_counts <- colony_size_site |>
#   select(island, site, n_colonies)

# Option B: Compute colony counts directly from `dive_clean` across all sites
# (Replace `colony_id` with your colony column, or use `n()` if each row is one colony)
colony_counts <- dive_clean |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies = sum(!is.na(height) | !is.na(width)), # or `n()` if 1 row = 1 colony
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_colony_count <- colony_counts |>
  mutate(site = fct_reorder(site, n_colonies)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n_colonies, y = site, fill = island)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n_colonies),
    hjust = -0.25,
    size = 3.6,
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Gorgonian Colonies",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Gorgonian Colony Count Across Survey Sites",
    fill = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

p_colony_count
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_colony_count_by_site.png"), p_colony_count, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```

#comparing gorgonian colonies with nutrient data

```{r}
# 1. Compute colony counts per site (includes 0-colony sites if present in dive_clean)
colony_counts <- dive_clean |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies = sum(!is.na(height) | !is.na(width)), # or `n()` if 1 row = 1 colony
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Join with cleaned site-level nutrient / Chl-a data and reshape to long format
# Update the column names in `c(...)` to match `nutrients_clean`
count_nutrients_long <- colony_counts |>
  left_join(nutrients_clean, by = c("island", "site")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(nitrate, phosphate, silicate, chl_a), # <-- edit to match your exact column names
    names_to = "nutrient_metric",
    values_to = "nutrient_value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_colonies), !is.na(nutrient_value))

# 3. Plot Number of Colonies vs. Nutrient Values across sites
p_count_nutrients <- count_nutrients_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = nutrient_value, y = n_colonies, color = island)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ nutrient_metric, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Lab Nutrient / Chlorophyll-a Concentration",
    y = "Number of Gorgonian Colonies",
    title = "Gorgonian Colony Count vs. Lab Water Chemistry by Site",
    subtitle = "Each point represents a survey site in Mauritius or Rodrigues",
    color = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_count_nutrients
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_colony_count_vs_nutrients.png"), p_count_nutrients, width = 9.5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

#comparing chlorophyll a conc with no of colonies

```{r}
# 1. Compute colony counts per site (keeps 0-colony sites so "presence/absence" is visible)
colony_counts <- dive_clean |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies = sum(!is.na(height) | !is.na(width)), # or `n()` if 1 row = 1 colony
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Join with cleaned site-level nutrient / Chl-a data
# Replace `chl_a` below with your exact cleaned chlorophyll-a column name
count_chla <- colony_counts |>
  left_join(nutrients_clean, by = c("island", "site")) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_colonies), !is.na(chl_a))

# 3. Quick non-parametric correlation check (Spearman is safer for small site counts & skewed data)
cor.test(count_chla$chl_a, count_chla$n_colonies, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

# 4. Plot Gorgonian Colony Count vs. Chlorophyll-a Concentration
p_count_chla <- count_chla |>
  ggplot(aes(x = chl_a, y = n_colonies)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "grey40",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = island), size = 3.5, alpha = 0.92) +
  labs(
    x = "Lab Chlorophyll-a Concentration (phytoplankton proxy)",
    y = "Number of Gorgonian Colonies",
    title = "Gorgonian Colony Abundance vs. Chlorophyll-a Across Sites",
    subtitle = "(dashed line = overall linear trend ± SE)",
    color = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_count_chla
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_colony_count_vs_chla.png"), p_count_chla, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```

#comparing colony count at depth

```{r}


# 1. Summarize colony count and depth per site
# Adjust `depth`, `height`, and `width` to match your cleaned column names in `dive_clean`
site_depth_counts <- dive_clean |>
  group_by(island, site) |>
  summarise(
    n_colonies = sum(!is.na(height) | !is.na(width)), # or `n()` if 1 row = 1 colony
    mean_depth = mean(depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(n_colonies), !is.na(mean_depth))

# 2. Plot Colony Count vs. Depth with a neat boxed legend on the right
p_count_depth <- site_depth_counts |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_depth, y = n_colonies, color = site, shape = island)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.95) +
   scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17)) + # solid circle & solid triangle for clear contrast
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.16))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean Survey Depth (m)",
    y = "Number of Gorgonian Colonies",
    title = "Gorgonian Colony Count vs. Depth by Survey Site",
    subtitle = "Site indicated by color; island indicated by point shape",
    color = "Site",
    shape = "Island"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.justification = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ),
    legend.box.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5)
  )

p_count_depth
ggsave(here::here("output/fig_colony_count_vs_depth.png"), p_count_depth, width = 9.5, height = 5.8, dpi = 300)
```
